title: drosera prostrata
intro: Drosera prostrata, commonly known as the creeping sundew, is a carnivorous plant species that captures and digests insects for nutrients due to its adaptation to poor soil conditions. The health benefits of Drosera prostrata include its potential to act as a diuretic, helping to reduce fluid retention and alleviate symptoms of urinary tract infections. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma, and exhibit expectorant properties, making it useful in treating coughs and congestion. The bioactive constituents of Drosera prostrata include iridoid glycosides, particularly droserone, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions.
